newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells 30,000/T Jan Cochin naphtha to Vitol.
newsitem.headline: India sells 30,000/T Jan Cochin naphtha to Vitol.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its export tender for 30,000 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha (HAN) lifting January 29-31 from Cochin on the west coast to Dutch trader Vitol at $20.98 per tonne below Japanese spot prices, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender closed January 9 and was valid until January 10. The award was made on a free-on-board basis (fob).
IOC's last Cochin HAN export, 25,000 tonnes lifting December 22-24, was sold at a higher price of $16.65 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes, fob.
